data.long_meaning: Means 'Gentle' or 'Kind' in Arabic. Derived from the Arabic word 'jawwad' which means 'to make soft' or 'to tame'. The name Jawwaad carries the meaning “Gentle, Kind” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jawwaad usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jawwaad is a name that represents the spiritual qualities of gentleness, beauty, and kindness. It is a name that resonates with the heart and inspires compassion and love.
data.etymology: Jawwaad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Kind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jawwaad total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
